business_summary: Handcrafted Italian leather handbags made to fit, sourced from Florence and priced around $1,200 with a 6-week shipping time.

relevant_tags.why: Handbags are a core fashion accessory closely aligned with apparel.
Luxury leather goods are often purchased as high-end gifts.

note_signals.why: Older affluent women with high AOV and responsiveness to quality messaging align well with luxury handcrafted leather goods.
Highest-AOV apparel publisher with a conservative brand sensibility matches luxury Florence leather handbags.
High-frequency impulse shoppers looking for instant delivery conflict with a $1,200 item that takes 6 weeks to ship.

gate_reason: Product, price, and fulfillment details are clear enough to plan campaigns with high-AOV publishers.
